tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phyir zlog pa ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pa tra gi ra man tra dhirba tsakra nā ma/ bod skad du/ phyir zlog pa ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ khro bo phyir zlog pa rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo// gang dag bdag la mi phan par 'dod pa dang*/ log par lta zhing rnam par sdang ba dang*/ gnod par sems zhing bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*/ byad du bcug cing khram la 'debs pa dang*/ bod gtong byed cing dmod ngan smo ba dang*/ mnan gtad byed pa dang*/ sbyin sreg byed pa dang*/ thun zor 'phen pa dang*/ gnod sems byed pa thams cad bsal du gsol/ med par mdzad du gsol/ rnam par 'joms su gsol/ phyir zlog tu gsol/ nyin dang mtshan du srung zlog mdzad du gsol/ oṃ a hri uṣṇī ṣa bi dza yan tsakra warti/ sarba lo ki bruṃ bruṃ druṃ druṃ/ ti sta ra lo ki skor/ yant+ra mant+ra/ bi shad tse ra ṇa/ tsurṇa pra yog yen ken ma ra ke ta ka ra ṇi/ shantsa te na sarba lo ki kaṃ pa ya kaṃ pa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhi tsurṇa pra ta ba ta/ bi dhāṃ na sa ya/ tshindha tshindha/ bindha bindha/ bhindha bhindha/ sad ta sad ta/ a mu ka na sha ya shantiṅku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa'i bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol lo/ phyir zlog tu gsol swā hā/ sarba tsi ta dhe ba bhi ga na ro myags kha tham srog gzir rbud nan/ drīl drīl/ rta phyug hrig shig rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la lha 'dre thams cad kyis bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ rgyan kha g.yos pa dang*/ dmod zor dang*/ dal kha g.yos pa dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog /oṃ ya manta ka ha ga nan rbad srungs shig /spyi gtsug krongs yu bhi bruṃ/ u sha khog pa nan/ hrig smugs su yig shog /phra yig kha yig bhi hi sprig nan yag pa ma ra ya dza/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gshin rjes 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/

rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ dmod zor byed pa dang*/ zor kha gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ badzra ki li kī la ya sarba bi gha nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba du ka shaṃ du ru rbad nan/ tha pa thaṃ tig nan/ hur thuṃ hur pa nan/ su ru su ru/ kro dha ya dhe raṃ ka /phos phos/ 'ub sha 'ub sha/ sma ra sha ku ra du ma de yed/ sho nam krubs krubs/ be ta li e man dzu/ ba sha la thums/ 'ubs shu 'ubs shu/ kha sha rog po rug pa naṃ/ hu ru hu ru/ go ro tsa na ma/ ag trang ag shaṃ/ rtsi shang ga ta ya nag po pra ti dza/ sha ling rbad/ bha ma hūṃ 'ub/ shi bhi shag rbad nan tsant+ri sha ra/ tre kre du na bhyo ka li ya/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la phur pas bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ dmod zor smo ba dang*/ gnod byed sarba bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ ru ru rag mo ma ma gang shar ma ra ma ra yā nan/ du ru dhi ri ma ra ya/ thums thums sa ma ya/ ma hā se na se na/ ha ma tra ru tra ya/ ru ru rag mo a pa ra bhyo na hur/ smar mo smar mo/ kha long kha long*/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la ma mo dang*/ mon mo dang*/ bal mo dang*/ sho na ma'i bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ dmod ngan smo ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ tsakra bhu ra bhu rbad/ shag bhyi trag shad/ kha trang kha trang*/ bi ti yug drag rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bram ze dang*/ drang srong dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis dmod zor dang*/ rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ ngan sngags dang gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ hri: ha he bha haṃ kaṃ ka kaṃ rang*/ khag ma re re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la ru tra pho brgyud thams cad kyis dmod zor dang*/ bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ gnod par byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ bha sri kha le mu la ka stod ma/ li ti pra ma ta sha sha ma ma khang khang*/ khong khong*/ tham tham/ thum thum/ smugs smugs/

smyogs smyogs/ 'das 'das/ 'dus 'dus/ ru ru rbad rbud/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la ru tra mo brgyud thams cad kyis bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ dmod mo dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba ḍho zlog rbad/ sarba bya khyung sa lings/ ma lings ma lings/ he he phaṭa phaṭa/ na ga bud pa u le shu/ na ga ra tsa mu le shu ba bha ra tsa na ga ni ga /badzra trag tra shra ho rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sa bdag mo dang*/ klu mo dang*/ gnyan mo dang*/ ma mo dang*/ bsen mo thams cad kyis gnod pa dang*/ bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ dmod zor dang*/ bcings pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ ra tsa snying kha rag rbad tha ma/ rbad rbad dam sri thums/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ dho/ rag mo rag mo ta ta kha kha bhyo bhyo/ hūṃ traṃ traṃ hūṃ/ mu ka dkar mo dza/ khrigs sho khrigs sho/ kha dun kha dun rbad/ thi haṃ thi haṃ/ ra ma bri ra ma thims tra sha pa ni/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rgyal po dang*/ rgyal phran dang*/ rgyal po thams cad kyis rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ dmod zor dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba ḍho zlog rbad/ oṃ badzra sa dwa sa ma ya ha sa bya hu sa bya/ tri ka ra sa ya gur gum na yakṣa phaṭa/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gtsang btsan dang*/ 'gong po dang*/ 'gong mo dang*/ 'byung po thams cad kyis rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ kham shog pa yug shog gur shig sha long sbrang yar/ spra shag du na kha rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod sbyin thams cad kyis rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba tsa bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ dur trad dur trad/ shri sbri mu ti pi li si kha ma lo ha he ri li bdud pra ma ni/ ma ti yu sha bhu ru yo na phaṭa/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bdud thams cad kyis bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba ḍho zlog rbad/ oṃ gha li ni du yang*/ me ma la a nan yakṣa kha long kha'i/

ya ma du ka pra ma bi li ru pa shag tshal par rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sa bdag dang klu gnyan thams cad kyis rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ 'ching ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba tsa bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ de ba pri ti nan/ ha ra thun bhyo/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bhyo hūṃ/ ra ga mo rag sha tri ti ni ri khrag nyag raṃ shag har thun/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ ngan sngags dang*/ dmod zor dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba ḍho zlog rbad/ oṃ sid dha si la/ bha tha ra si na dha dhi ra/ mā ra ya rbad/ pha ra me sa pa dhu ru bhi ra ma sa na/ siddhi u sa dha tha/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la nang pa sangs rgyas pas bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ drag sngags kyi gnod pa thams cad tsa bhyo zlog rbad/ oṃ sad ta sad ti/ sa pa sa tha ra khyi li sid ti li ra sa spa ra spu ra/ pa ra me sa ra gu ru bhi ra ya/ bha na si te u raṃ tha/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la phyi pa mu stegs pa thams cad kyis bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ ngan sngags kyi gnod pa byed pa thams cad sarba tsa bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ yang te sgyur par te khrol/ rbad de dza zlog /e ka du nas zlog /tsa dur snying nas zlog /sa ga du nas zlog /ma hā du nas zlog /kha thun rbad nas zlog /rakṣa rbad nas zlog /yakṣa rbad nas zlog /ra tsa rbad nas zlog /su tri ra tsa ya zlog /bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la srid pa pho brgyud kyi lha 'dre mthu bo che thams cad kyis rbod gtong gtong ba dang*/ rbad 'dre byed pa thams cad sarba tsa dho zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ ma mo ra tsa ya ma dgra la bhyo zlog /shan tre gsham mo zlog /rakṣa ma ti sha na mo ru bhyo sa ma ya zlog /rag mo glad tri pa la yā/ e ka tsa ti pa la yā/ mi sha dgra la rbad/ tsa dur snying nas zlog /thum byer bhyo nas zlog /bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la srid pa mo brgyud kyi lha 'dre mthu mo che thams cad kyis bod gtong gtong ba dang*/

rbad 'dre byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ na ga dunas zlog /sa ga du nas zlog /du du nan zlog /sa du nan zlog /snying du nan zlog /sha du nan zlog /nā ga le le/ dum pa le le/ ku ru sod ta ni/ ku ru dza hūṃ bhyo/ nā ga tsi ta snying khrag ril/ snying ta tsi ta snying*/ nā ga'i sha la rbad bhyo/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sa bdag dang*/ sa srin dang*/ klu srin dang*/ klu rigs thams cad kyis rbad 'dre dang rbod gtong gtong ba thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ klu'i mnan gtad du bcug pa dang 'ching bar byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ na ma pri hring rtsi/ nyi ma bhi ta yā kro ta yā/ dzwa la dzwa la/ na ma nā gra ra tsa yā/ e pra dzwa la pu ta pu ta/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sdang bar byed pa thams cad a mu ka ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo khyod kyi nus pa thams cad zhi bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bdag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung du gsol lo// bskyab tu gsol lo// sgrib tu gsol lo// rakṣa ku ru ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la mant+ra sarba lo ka sa ha/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la mgon po yongs dang*/ chos skyong pho brgyud thams cad kyi rbad gtong gtong ba dang*/ 'ching ba tham sa cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ ma hā tsa munt+ri mant+ra sarba lo ki ke swā hā/ bdag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la lha mo dang*/ ma mo dang*/ chos skyong srid pa mo brgyud thams cad kyi rbad 'dre dang*/ rbod gtong byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ma hā sa na ga mant+ra sarba ke ka swā hā/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sa bdag dang*/ klu gnyan thams cad kyis bod gtong gtong ba thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ pa ra te mant+ra sa mant+ra ba re maṃ ge long ge /bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bram ze dang*/ drang srong dang*/

mtha' mi gdug pa can thams cad kyi ngan sngags dang*/ dmod zor gtong ba thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ sha truṃ a mu ka tsi ta naṃ/ mant+ra du nas bhyo zlog /yantu du nas zlog /sa ti du nas zlog /mu tra du nas zlog /sa ma ya du nas zlog /bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub mo byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ aṃ badzra ga ra badzra ka ba la/ badzra ma tha tsha ba yid la/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rbad 'dre dang*/ bod gtong gtong ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ khro bo'i drag shul byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gshin rje'i 'khor lo skor ba thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ phur pa'i dbal kha 'phen pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ma mo'i thun zor 'phen pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ lha'i bka' chad babs pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bdud kyi khram la btab pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ rgyal po'i chad pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ klu'i gtad khram du bcug pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gza'i byed phur phog pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ rgyu skar gyi gzer kha phog pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ btsan gyi zhags pas 'debs pa thams cad sarba dho zlog dgra la rbad/ gnod sbyin gyi rbud pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ dmu'i gnam rdo lhung ba thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gnyan gyi dal kha g.yos pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ sa bdag gi dal kha g.yos pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mu stegs kyi ngan sngags 'byung ba thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ drang srong gi dmod pa zug pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ma mo'i dal kha g.yos pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/

rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ the'u rang 'byung po'i cho 'phrul thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bod gtong dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ phur kha gnod cing 'tshe ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ sarba ku ru ya myags/ tsi ti ku ru ya myags/ dun tri ku ru ya myags/ ma hā sha pa ra tsa spang ka tsa/ ka pa ya phaṭa/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la rgya gar gyi ngan sngags 'byung ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ rgya nag gi sgyur lto byed pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ dpyad mkhan gyi bhyo lto gtong ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bal po'i ku dug gshom pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mi nyag gi tsa dur 'bor ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ zhang zhung gi tso dmar 'phen pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ sum pa'i glang zor 'phen pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ stag gzig gi zor mda' zug pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bod kyis dmod zor ngan pa smos pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ban dhe'i ban zor 'phen pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bon po'i bon zor 'phen pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gyim shang dgra gshed bskor ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ skyes pas mda' zor drag po 'phen pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ 'bangs mos thal zor 'phen pa thams cad dho zlog dgra la rbad/ bud med mang pos dmod zor ngan pa smo ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ phur kha zor kha rbad 'dre bod gtong byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ rbad tshal pa sa ma ya zlog /ḍho brgyad phaṭa sa ma ya zlog /smyugs ti rmugs ti sa ma ya zlog /tsi ti ru tri sa ma ya zlog /sme sha ku ru sa ma ya zlog /tsi ta rbad sa ma ya zlog /bdag la gnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di'i sha long khrag long*/ dbugs long mnga' la de khye/

a mu ka mā ra ya rbad/ bdag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod pa sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ yas kyi bdud g.yos pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mas kyi sri langs pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ pha tshan gyi rgya 'dre langs pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ma tshan gyi byur 'dre langs pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ dar tshan gyi stong 'dre langs pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ yul mi dang pha spun gyis byol lto gtong ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ oṃ badzra ya tri ya tri ma ra bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ni lang ba ra da ra rbad/ tri ma hi ri hi ri/ gtubs gtubs/ snying khar ga dunt+re rbad/ srog la rbad/ dbugs la rngubs/ sha rus khrag rtsa la nur nur/ oṃ ma tsa dur tri na pa la bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig ga gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu'i gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ dus mi 'chi ba rnam pa brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ rkyen dang bar chad byed pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ hūṃ hri ba ta ya mo ha bā sha yā zlog zlog /hūṃ badzra ya tri mā ra ya dza/ spugs cig spugs cig thibs phur nan swā hā/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i lo skag dang*/ zla skag dang*/ zhag skag dang*/ za skag dang*/ bdud skag dang*/ nad skag dang*/ 'chi skag dang*/ tshe zad za 'brangs thebs pa dang*/ ki kang dang*/ gshed bzhi dang*/ chags che ba thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/

za nyes pa dang*/ sgom nyes pa dang*/ skom 'thung nyes pa dang*/ gros bya nyes pa dang*/ ngan pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gza' dang rgyu skar tshes grangs nyes pa dang*/ mi mthun mi shis pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ sha ri bhyo zlog /khrag ma ma bhyo zlog /tsi ra snying bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mi ti thod khrag dza/ khrag ti snying la ya/ ni tri chod/ mu lo chod/ sha lo chod/ sha la kying kying*/ bhyo sa ma ya a ti/ tri ma ta ni pa ra ni bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ gdon gegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi chags che dang*/ nyam nga ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ltas ngan yul sdigs thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mo ngan pa dang*/ pra sdigs ngan pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ bya ba nyes pa dang*/ mna'i nyes pa dang*/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ phyogs ngan 'dre lnga bdud gcod thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ pha mes kyi 'dre ngan langs pa thams cad ḍho zlog dgra la rbad/ gri sri dang mtshon sri gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mya ngan gnod grib gnod pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ dgra kha mtshon kha zug pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ nad kha rims kha zug pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ ngan brjod mi kha gzug pa thams cad bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ mi rung mi 'phrod pa mi shis pa thams cad sarba bhyo zlog dgra la rbad/ nag po tsi ti pra ma rakṣa sad ku ru tra/ myags rbad myogs rbad/ nag po tsi ti snying la rbad/ thod pa rug po tra ya rbad/ snying la dum bur rbud/ snying la rbud thums/ sa ma ya langs te sgyur/ sarba duṣṭaṃ shrī yang rbud/ ta khug lo ka pra ma thigs phur sod/ ni sa phur sod/ bod gtong phur kha gnod pa thams cad sarba dho zlog dgra la rbad/

bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod par sems pa dang*/ sdang bar sems pa thams cad kyi rang mthu rang la zug cig /rang nus rang la zlog cig /rang srog rang gis chod cig /dgra bo kho rang gi lha srung kho rang gi gshed du phob cig /bdud du phob cig /sarba bhyo zlog dgra la mā ra ya rbad/ hūṃ ban dhe sha ya myogs ma lo sha ya rbad/ lto lo sha ya rbad/ nu lo sha ya rbad/ ban dhe brag tshal pa srog rtsa chod/ snying rtsa chod/ tshal pa rbad/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bod gtong phur kha gnod pa thams cad dam nyams a mu ka phye mar phur ya/ bdag gis phyir zlog pa ngan sngags 'di brjod pa'i mthus/ phas kyi rgol ba dang*/ sdang bar sems pa dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub mo byed pa dang*/ sbyin sreg byed pa dang*/ gyim shad skor ba dang*/ mnan gtad du bcug pa dang*/ gnod par byed pa thams cad kyi mthu dang*/ nus pa thams cad bcings so// gzir ro// mnan to// gnod byed thams cad sarba bhyo zlog go /phyir zlog pa ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo 'di ni rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba dang*/ nad yams chen po byung ba dang*/ lha 'dre'i dal kha g.yos pa dang*/ rgyan kha g.yos pa dang*/ spyad mkhan gyi gyim shang skor ba dang*/ byol lto gtong ba dang*/ ban bon gyis mnan gtad du bcug pa dang*/ sngags pa'i 'phur pas 'brub pa dang*/ phur kha drag pos gnod pa dang*/ de rnams gang byung yang nangs nub bam/ dgong mo nyi ma dmar thag chad tshun chod la/ nya stong dus bzhi la drag po'i sngags rgod 'di nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ yang na bcu bzhi 'am/ lan bdun bton par gyur na/ phur thogs stong gis bsgrubs kyang gnod par mi 'gyur ro// bzlas pas ri gzar kyi rbab kyang gyen du zlog go /phas kyi rbod gtong smos ci dgos zhes gsungs so// srung zlog sbrags ma'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i sngags 'bum 'di slob dpon padmas gsungs pa'o// 'di las lhag pa'i zlog pa ni// rta rmig lcags kyis gtums nas su/
'jig rten ma lus btsal gyur kyang*// rnyed par gyur re na ra kan// de bas 'di nyid kho na'o// zhes gsungs so// maṅga laṃ/// /
